name: Fabien Di Filippo
detail: Voted for the single article of the 2% floor-tax bill (scrutin 878, 2025-02-20) but not for the bill as a whole (scrutin 881), and tabled amendments to change it; his article vote is not read as support.

name: Anne-Laure Blin
detail: Same as Di Filippo: voted for the article (scrutin 878) but not for the bill (scrutin 881).

name: Maxime Michelet
detail: Same as Di Filippo: voted for the article (scrutin 878) but not for the bill (scrutin 881).

name: Lutte ouvrière
detail: Editorial of 7 Nov 2025 defends the principle against the bourgeois campaign but calls the 2% Zucman tax something that "n’avait pas de quoi casser trois pattes à un canard" and an illusion of justice; no endorsement.

name: 16 French business leaders (appeal of 23 Aug 2011)
detail: Ask for an unspecified "contribution exceptionnelle" from the most favoured taxpayers; no reference to wealth in the reports opened.
